notes.title: The Gun Update
notes.notes:
Hello all BYLErs, we've got a brand new update with some new content that you'll love.

3 new guns for you to save the city with or prove your worth in the colosseum.

[h2]Charmer Gun[/h2]
Send musical melodies and snakes at your enemy and poison them to slow them down. Or using the right click, cause them to perch, waiting for the right moment to strike.
[img]https://i.imgur.com/oI1oQ2E.png[/img]

[h2]Plasma Gun[/h2]
Electrify your enemies with balls of super heated plasma. These flaming hot balls will pierce through your enemies, try to get a multi kill!
[img]https://i.imgur.com/RU4YOOc.png[/img]

[h2]Ray Gun[/h2]
Last but certainly not least, the Ray Gun. Use this highly experimental weapon that uses BYLE to disintegrate your foes.
[img]https://i.imgur.com/hEYZA8R.png[/img]

We have also fixed a couple bugs in the game as well as a quality of life update for the Dualies. You can use both the left click and the right click to fire them.

Hope you BYLErs will enjoy the new weapons.

Thanks for your continued support :)

notes.title: BYLE UPDATE
notes.notes:
Hello BYLErs,

The team at ST. JARLE brings you excellent news. There is a BYLE update. God bless.

This update brings not only [b]NEW CONTENT[/b] but also [b]Q.O.L.[/b] features too.

[h1]ALL THE CHANGES[/h1]
[h2]WEAPONS[/h2]
[h3]SAWED-OFF SHOTGUN[/h3]
A shotgun that fires loads of projectiles in a larger spread than the regular shotgun.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44639084/f3a95194584aef4053cf96eae84079f4bb01975c.png[/img]
[h3]DUALIES[/h3]
Dual pistols. It's like one pistol, but you have two of them. In each hand. No one could have seen this coming.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44639084/e726c98f651cbcbe9e4c9902dc1cd373e6c55677.png[/img]
[h3]BOOMBURST[/h3]
A form of ranged shotgun. Fires a one large projectile. But after a certain distance that ball will explode into little pieces, as if you had fired the regular shotgun.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44639084/0ce5bd4a68c31edc18893f695c454169b4c12265.png[/img]

[h2]POWERUPS[/h2]
[h3]FAMILIAR[/h3]
Picking up this one spawns a little BYLE baby that orbits you and attacks enemies.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44639084/1468811a7d82b41f42f64cd058312e36e2d184dc.png[/img]

[h2]QUALITY OF LIFE / OTHER CHANGES[/h2]
[h3]KEY REBINDS[/h3]
You can now change the controls. Anyone who didn't like dodge roll being on space can rest easily now that they can properly dodge bullets.
[h3]POWERUP TRACKER[/h3]
Any powerup you pickup is now tracked and can be viewed mid run. Hold tab and you can hover over it to get the specifics on what that powerup did.
[h3]V-SYNC[/h3]
BYLE now syncs to V. Incredible.
[h3]AUTO-RELOAD[/h3]
This change is my favourite.
[h3]BUG FIXES[/h3]
[list]
[*]Sniper will no longer shoot in the wrong direction.
[*]Jank with the flamethrower (both you and enemies) has been reduced.
[*]Fixed some walls that were rectangular in nature in levels 1 & 2.
[*]Enemy pathfinding in the colosseum has been improved.
[*]Other small things we didn't write down, but trust me bro, we fixed more.
[/list][h3]OTHER BALANCE CHANGES THAT ARNIE THOUGHT WAS NECESSARY[/h3]

Join our [url=https://discord.gg/6hm5d7qs83]discord[/url] if you want to suggest anything else though. We might add it. Unless it's a skill tree.

- Employee of month, Seb
